title: Default News edition and language from browser locale
question: Can the News root open the US edition and choose English or Chinese from the browser language without overriding an explicit reader choice?
hypotheses: A browser-language fallback in the reader, combined with an explicit US root redirect, will make a first visit English for English browsers and Chinese for Chinese browsers while preserving URL and saved manual choices.
acceptance_criteria: News root routes to the US edition instead of TW.
A first US visit defaults to English for an English browser and Chinese for a Chinese browser.
Explicit lang URL state and an existing manual language choice remain authoritative.
TW behavior and reader navigation contracts remain intact.
evidence: Owner requested browser-locale defaults with US as the landing edition.
